help.title: 📄 Large PDF Upload Guide
help.intro: The Document Translation Centre can translate large PDF files. However, some PDFs can reach very large file sizes because of high-resolution scans and large images.
help.s1Step1: Save your PDF file to your computer.
help.s1Step3: Choose the Medium Quality or High Quality option.
help.s1Step5: Upload the new PDF file to the system again.
help.s1Note: In most cases, large PDF files can be reduced below 50 MB without loss of quality.
help.s2Body: You can split large PDFs into several parts and translate them separately.
help.s3Body: In some PDFs, high-resolution images make up most of the file size. After PDF optimisation, the same content can be uploaded at a much smaller size.
help.faq1Q: My PDF is very large. Can it be translated?
help.faq1A: In most cases, yes. However, uploading large files may take longer.
help.faq2A: Yes. The system tries to detect the text using OCR.
help.faq3Q: Can I translate PDFs with tables?
help.faq3A: Yes. Simple tables are usually preserved. Complex tables may show layout differences.
help.toolsBody: These tools can be used to reduce the size of PDF files.
